page_title: MON 4-6 EIN | B. Monchengladbach v Eintracht Frankfurt 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' 4 - 6 It's in the back of the net! Joe Scally puts the ball on a plate for Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach), who has an easy finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 4:6.
90+5' This is a yellow card! Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+5' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+1' Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+1' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Eintracht Frankfurt have a free kick.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
89' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
87' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) is caught offside!
86' Referee Soren Storks points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) goes wild in celebration.
85' Wait! Referee Soren Storks has indicated he is going to review the B. Monchengladbach goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
83' 3 - 6 Goal! Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 3:6.
83' A corner kick by Eintracht Frankfurt is thwarted by the well prepared Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach).

83' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. The linesman makes the right call and B. Monchengladbach will have a corner.
82' Eugen Polanski has decided to make a change. Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Lukas Ullrich.

78' 2 - 6 Luca Netz sends in a great cross from the corner and finds Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach), who outjumps the defence to put the ball into the roof of the net with a stunning header. The score is 2:6.
78' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Nathaniel Brown.
77' The ball is cleared after Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to B. Monchengladbach.
75' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
74' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. They send men into the box.

72' 1 - 6 Goal – 1:6! Joe Scally sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the left side of the goal.
71' Here is a change. Jonathan Burkardt is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes onto the pitch for Ritsu Doan.

70' What a great touch by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.

69' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Soren Storks blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Eintracht Frankfurt.

68' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
68' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
65' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up an injury.
64' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

64' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) stoops for a header low near the left post from a cross, but the goalkeeper pulls off a great save! The ball is out of play and B. Monchengladbach manage to earn a corner.
64' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
64' B. Monchengladbach will take a corner kick.

63' A lofted pass picks out Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, B. Monchengladbach are going to take it.
61' Eugen Polanski has decided to substitute Shuto Machino and he is replaced by Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach).
61' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Rocco Reitz as he is replaced by Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach).
61' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
59' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' The corner kick from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

58' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner.
57' Dino Toppmoller prepares a substitution. Nnamdi Collins is replaced by Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt).
57' Can Yilmaz Uzun goes off the pitch and Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.

56' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! That's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
55' Soren Storks couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) and blew his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to B. Monchengladbach.

53' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Moritz Nicolas was alert and the score remains the same.
52' B. Monchengladbach are ruled offside.
51' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
49' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
49' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post.
47' 0 - 6 Goal! Nathaniel Brown puts a cross into the box and finds Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:6.
47' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt). The referee signals a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
46' Corner kick. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

45+1' 0 - 5 Goal! Fares Chaibi plays in Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders. He shoots from inside the box into the right side of the net! Great finish - 0:5.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Eintracht Frankfurt take a short corner kick.

43' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance. Eintracht Frankfurt earn a corner.
42' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Eintracht Frankfurt are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

39' 0 - 4 Goal Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt)! Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) was put through by Ritsu Doan and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 0:4.
38' A substitution has been made. Kevin Stoger is replaced by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach).
38' Eugen Polanski decides to make a substitution. Fabio Cristian Chiarodia will be replaced by Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach).
38' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

35' 0 - 3 Goal! Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Can Yilmaz Uzun inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:3.
35' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Kaua Santos is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
34' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.

33' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. Eintracht Frankfurt earn a free kick.
33' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
31' Soren Storks blows his whistle. Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
30' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.

29' It looks like Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) saw red with that tackle. Soren Storks won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. B. Monchengladbach will take a free kick near the side line.
28' A nice individual effort by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.

25' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Soren Storks blows for a foul. B. Monchengladbach win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
24' Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) is flagged for offside.
23' Moritz Nicolas displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
22' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

22' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Eintracht Frankfurt.
20' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough challenge and Soren Storks blows his whistle for an infringement. B. Monchengladbach will take a free kick.
19' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom left corner. Kaua Santos is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
18' Soren Storks sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
17' The Eintracht Frankfurt players halt their celebrations as referee Soren Storks makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.

16' 0 - 2 Goal! Ritsu Doan manages to prod the ball to Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:2.
14' Soren Storks blows the whistle, Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) is penalised for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Eintracht Frankfurt.

11' 0 - 1 Goal! Fares Chaibi sent in a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) and his bullet header from around the penalty spot went straight into the right side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
11' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

10' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The ball goes out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
8' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.

8' Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Eintracht Frankfurt win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
7' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
5' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Soren Storks blows for a foul. Eintracht Frankfurt have a free kick.
3' The linesman raises his flag. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is adjudged offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Eintracht Frankfurt will have the kick-off.
Soren Storks will officiate today.
